meta.title: Dragon's Kingdom - S01E01 - shot list of the locked shooting script
meta.status: PLAN ONLY. Nothing has been rendered for the final script. Durations are animatic estimates, not measured footage. Every addition and rating-pass shot is proposed (SERIES.md section 5): in the script by default, not canon until Daxtyn accepts it.
meta.delivery: native 3840x2160, 24 fps, --preset final on every frame (SERIES.md section 2)
meta.ids: Handoff shots keep their ../shotlist.json ids (P-01 ... 3D-16, E-01); X#-NN are shots of proposed addition X#; R#-NN of rating-pass block R#; a letter suffix (1F-14b, X11-05b) is a picture added by a CHANGED block.
meta.estimate_model: Same as ../shotlist.json: expected = dialogue + action + breath (rounded to 0.5 s); low = 0.9/0.8/0.5 x; high = 1.15/1.3/1.5 x; dialogue = final/dialogue.json est_seconds + 0.35 s cue gap per line. End titles 30/40/60 s by hand. The action and breath seconds of every addition and rating-pass block equal check_final.py's tables, so both tools give the same runtime.
meta.lens: Full-frame-equivalent focal length suggested per shot: default by shot size (EWS 24, WS 35, MS 50, CU 85, INS 100 macro), long lenses where two dragons share the frame.
meta.native_4k_s_per_frame: Seconds of rendering per 4K frame on this 4-vCPU CPU-only machine, one browser, velocity motion blur: MEASURED style-frame figures and estimates derived from them (see render-schedule.md).

sets.description: Black frame or text on black. No 3D render: generated by the encoder (black) or a cheap 2D text page.
Prologue: open sea, rocky shore, island lost in cloud, small wooden sailing vessel, fog bank. Dawn.

Prologue dissolves: coastal settlement, open sea, forest reaching a cliff, distant fortified walls, far unreached islands, wing-shaped cloud. Built from the same terrain/sea generators as the other sets. No map, no borders.
Interior, Verdor: stone chamber, high daylight opening, lamps, prepared nest with bedding, bowls of water, folded cloth, the gold egg/hatchling. No magical apparatus.

Exterior, Verdor riding grounds: open grass field with a cleared launch area, Charcoal's grounded access rig, a low platform for Leaf, ground keepers, building doorway at the field edge. Also reused for the prologue's present-day shadow shot (meadow edge).
Air: coast and island of Verdor on the inland side (screen LEFT in establishing shots), open sea on the other. Palace visible far off. Used for 1C (after take-off), 1D, 1E and Abby's intercuts in 1F.
Air/sea: outer coast, a coastal outcrop, outer rocks, a low bank of sea mist, bright open water. Same ocean/terrain generator as SKY_OFF_VERDOR, different region. Used for 1F.
Interior, Verdor: working room with daylight opening (coastline and outer rocks visible through it), seat, clean cloth, water; doorway to a corridor. 2B and 2C.
Exterior, Verdor harbor: weathered steps down to the quay, the Santa Maria (name on hull only if legible), crew, ropes, supplies, a lookout. 2C insert.

Exterior, Cling (within Scrapper): approach street, festival square with a fountain at the center (raised edge plus a central stone pillar: the continuous reference landmark, readable at foot level and above the dust), a separate substantial stone support by the king's steps (cover for the king and captain), vendor stall (left-center) with alley behind, music space (right-center), stone arch exit (screen LEFT from the steps), gate to broad road (screen RIGHT from the steps), banners, timber and gray stone. Must also exist in a damaged/dusty state for 3C-3D. Same layout as assets.json set.cling_village_square.
Air above and around Cling: village small in its landscape, sky and cloud, Starlight and Queen Fall in flight, high views down onto the square.
Interior, Verdor palace: the queen's own room at first light; a window over the sea, an unslept bed, a sill with a wine jug and one cup (X1, R1).
Interior, Verdor palace: stone corridors with tall windows at intervals and daylight at the far end; a turn where no one can see (X1, X2, X13).

Air over Verdor's harbor and town: curved harbor wall, quay, slipway, nets on frames, market street, terraced hillside, the riding-school field, the palace on its high ground with the birthing chamber's high opening (X4, X9).
Sea stacks off the end of Verdor's coast: two leaning stacks with a narrow gap opening seaward, seabird ledges, white water, a low bank of sea mist on the seaward side. Must match in X6, X8 and 1F.
The Santa Maria's deck, rail and masthead at the quay: furled sails, coiled rope, the ship's boat, the off-watch crew's corner (X9, R4, R5, R9, X16).
The grassy field above Verdor's harbor at ground level: young riders, small dragons, the instructor (X16).
The broad road outside Cling and the gate from outside: country people, carts, farmland, dust (X14).

conventions.flight_line_1C_to_1E: Flight line: travel screen LEFT to RIGHT, camera on the inland side. Leaf LEFT/near and slightly behind, Charcoal RIGHT/far and ahead. Island on the inland side, open sea beyond them. Because they travel screen-right, this camera sees the dragons' and riders' RIGHT sides; their LEFT sides face seaward, away from camera. In singles, Remi looks screen-LEFT toward Abby and Abby looks screen-RIGHT toward Remi.
conventions.the_pass_1E: Travel stays screen LEFT to RIGHT with the camera on the inland side, so the camera sees Leaf's and Abby's RIGHT sides. The scout comes head-on from ahead (enters frame RIGHT), crosses R-to-L and cuts through the gap between Leaf and Charcoal: it passes along Leaf's LEFT (seaward) side, the FAR side from camera, never between Leaf and the camera. The wake hits Abby's LEFT side; her LEFT arm is the arm wrenched. Leaf rolls to his RIGHT (away from the wake, toward the inland side and the camera). The injury close-up 1E-04 is a declared neutral-axis shot from directly ahead of Leaf: Abby faces camera, so her LEFT arm is on screen RIGHT. 1E-05 returns to the inland side (her RIGHT hand grips in the foreground; the injured LEFT arm is held in on the far side). In 1F, Leaf heads inland = screen LEFT, so his and Abby's LEFT sides face camera again (1F-09). Do not mirror any of these shots.
the_pass_1E_topdown: TOP-DOWN VIEW, 1E (travel = screen RIGHT for the inland camera)
- - - - gap - - - - - - <=== SCOUT      (comes head-on from ahead, passes through the gap)
LEAF + ABBY  ===>                       (behind, near camera; LEFT side faces the gap)
[CAMERA, inland side, looking seaward]       [1E-04 camera: ahead of Leaf, looking back]
conventions.pursuit_1F: Leaf heads inland (screen LEFT). The scout runs along the outer coast (screen RIGHT/far). Charcoal turns between them. For the wing-separation shot the camera is above and behind the scout, so its LEFT wing is screen LEFT against bright water.
conventions.sun_verdor: Morning-to-day sun is over the sea side. On the inland-side camera axis the sea and sun are behind the action (rim light), so faces need fill light.
conventions.verdor_grounds_map: Charcoal and his access rig on screen RIGHT (the large cleared launch area). Leaf and Abby across the field on screen LEFT, near the building doorway. The ground keeper stands at the far-left field edge.
conventions.birthing_chamber_map: Nest in the center, Alexandria on screen RIGHT of the nest, attendant on LEFT, door at LEFT background. Abby crouches front-left.
conventions.treatment_room_map: Camera faces seated Abby. Her LEFT arm (injured) is screen RIGHT, where the healer works. Alexandria kneels screen LEFT and holds Abby's RIGHT hand. Door and opening are on the LEFT background, and the coast is visible through the opening.
conventions.cling_map: Cling map from the king's steps: stone arch LEFT, gate to broad road RIGHT, vendor stall left-center with alley behind, music space right-center, fountain with a central stone pillar at the center (the reference landmark), a separate stone support by the steps. Keep these fixed through the attack. Any reverse angle must be declared in camera_move and mirror these positions. The sun is behind the steps (south). Starlight approaches from the far (north) sky. Pass 1 crosses north to south, striking the north-west festival structures and roofline. Pass 2 is a low sweep after she banks beyond the village.
conventions.scale: Leaf's body is about a quarter of Charcoal's length (DRAGONS.md 2026-10-09; Charcoal about 36 m long), not one-twentieth. Starlight is roughly twice Charcoal's size. Keep the difference readable with long lenses in every shot that shows two of them.
conventions.dragons_on_the_ground: Dragon on the ground: low and level, belly near the ground, two legs folded or standing under the MIDDLE of the body, folded wings' wrists touching down in front. No dog-sit on the haunches, no upright or rearing pose (DRAGONS.md 2026-10-16).
conventions.outer_rocks: The outer rocks off the end of Verdor's coast: two leaning stacks with a gap that opens seaward, mist on the seaward side. X6 (race) and X8 (pursuit) use the same layout; the scout falls close to the coast just seaward of the rocks (1F, 2B, 2C).
conventions.time_of_day: Verdor: X1 first light; 1A-1C, X2-X6 morning; 1D-1F, X7-X9, 2A late morning; 2B-2C and X11-X13 day; X14 Cling midday; X15-X16 afternoon; X17-X19 later that day into golden late afternoon. Cling: X5 early morning (same hour as the flight), X14 midday, 3A-3D afternoon.
conventions.blood_continuity: The scout's blood on Remi from the bite (1F): spattered and streaked on face, neck, hands and sleeves; none of it his. Same pattern in every shot until R8. After R8 (keeper's cloth): face mostly scrubbed, streaks left at the hairline and down the neck; hands and sleeves still dark. After X11 (his mother wipes hairline, neck and hands) and R9b (hands scrubbed at the healer's bowl): hands clean, red from scrubbing; sleeves stained for the rest of the day. The scout's blood on Charcoal's lower jaw and throat from the bite until Remi washes it off in X15: wet at first, drying dark. Charcoal has no wound of his own. Adult villager: split scalp (blood down one side of the face into the collar) and an open fracture of the RIGHT leg below the knee, from the second pass to the end; leg splinted with a banner pole in X27. He lives.

continuity_flag_definitions.ABBY_BOTH_HANDS_BEFORE_PASS: Before the pass Abby uses both hands normally (set-up for the change).
continuity_flag_definitions.ABBY_LEFT_ARM_INJURY_EVENT: The pass wrenches Abby's LEFT arm. Do not mirror the shot.
continuity_flag_definitions.ABBY_LEFT_ARM_INJURED: Abby's LEFT arm is injured: held in, never used normally. Uses her right hand.
continuity_flag_definitions.ABBY_SLING_LEFT: Abby's LEFT arm is in a sling (from 2C onward).
continuity_flag_definitions.SCOUT_LEFT_WING_LOST: The scout lost its LEFT wing. Never show the right wing missing.
continuity_flag_definitions.SCOUT_RIDER_UNIDENTIFIED: Scout rider stays unidentified: no face, insignia, or speech.
continuity_flag_definitions.NO_WEAPON_STRIKE: The fracture comes from the pass and its wake, not from a weapon, bite, fall, or projectile.
continuity_flag_definitions.BURNED_RIDER_ALIVE: The burned rider is alive when last seen: strapped on, moving.
continuity_flag_definitions.NO_DEATH_DECLARED: Nobody declares the scout or its rider dead in Episode 1.
continuity_flag_definitions.STARLIGHT_NO_WOUNDS: Starlight has NO wounds (no later-episode wing injuries).
continuity_flag_definitions.STARLIGHT_NO_FIRE: Starlight never breathes fire in this episode. Damage comes only from the dive, contact, and her wake.
continuity_flag_definitions.STARLIGHT_SIZE: Starlight is roughly twice Charcoal's size. Reflective white scales; no glow, no literal crystal.
continuity_flag_definitions.ATTACK_NO_FLAME: "Attack" means a physical attack. It never triggers flame.
continuity_flag_definitions.FIRE_ONLY_ON_FIRE_COMMAND: Charcoal's flame happens only after "Fire", and it is brief.
continuity_flag_definitions.CHARCOAL_NOT_FASTER: Charcoal is never faster than the scout in a straight line. He closes through height, angles and the scout's turns.
continuity_flag_definitions.LEAF_INITIATES_NIP: Leaf starts it with one quick, harmless nip.
continuity_flag_definitions.LEAF_UNHARMED: Leaf is unharmed by the head-in-mouth beat. Teeth never close through skin.
continuity_flag_definitions.SIZE_DISPARITY: Leaf's body is about a quarter of Charcoal's length (DRAGONS.md 2026-10-09; Charcoal ~36 m). Use long lenses so a foreground Leaf does not cheat the scale.
continuity_flag_definitions.HATCHLING_NO_GLOW: The gold hatchling reflects light but never emits it. It is weak and has no name.
continuity_flag_definitions.ORIGINAL_LINE_EXACT: An [ORIGINAL] line: use the exact wording.
continuity_flag_definitions.ABBY_SILENCE: Abby does not answer the succession question: no words, no nod, no narration.
continuity_flag_definitions.SCREEN_DIRECTION: Flight line: travel screen LEFT to RIGHT, camera on the inland side. Leaf LEFT/near and slightly behind, Charcoal RIGHT/far and ahead. Island on the inland side, open sea beyond them. Because they travel screen-right, this camera sees the dragons' and riders' RIGHT sides; their LEFT sides face seaward, away from camera.
continuity_flag_definitions.SPEAKING_DISTANCE: Airborne/field speakers are close enough to hear each other. Wind sits between the lines; no shouted conversations across impossible distances.
continuity_flag_definitions.REMI_CHECKS_ABBY_FIRST: Remi confirms Abby is secured and Leaf is stable before he pursues.
continuity_flag_definitions.FIELD_CLEAR: The launch field is cleared. No bystanders are endangered for spectacle.
continuity_flag_definitions.CLING_ROUTES: Cling map from the king's steps: stone arch LEFT, gate to broad road RIGHT, vendor stall left-center with alley behind, music space right-center, fountain with a central stone pillar at the center (the reference landmark), a separate stone support by the steps. Keep these fixed through the attack. Any reverse angle must be declared in camera_move and mirror these positions.
continuity_flag_definitions.TRAITOR_IS_SUSPICION_ONLY: Traitor is a suspicion, not a confirmed identity or motive.
continuity_flag_definitions.SCOUT_OWN_DESIGN: The scout is a small, very fast dragon of its own design (no species, DRAGONS.md 2026-10-09): two legs, wings as forelimbs, horns.
continuity_flag_definitions.LOW_STANCE: Dragon on the ground: low and level, belly near the ground, two legs folded or standing under the MIDDLE of the body, folded wings' wrists touching down in front. No dog-sit on the haunches, no upright or rearing pose (DRAGONS.md 2026-10-16).
continuity_flag_definitions.REMI_BLOOD_1: The scout's blood on Remi from the bite (1F): spattered and streaked on face, neck, hands and sleeves; none of it his. Same pattern in every shot until R8.
continuity_flag_definitions.REMI_BLOOD_2: After R8 (keeper's cloth): face mostly scrubbed, streaks left at the hairline and down the neck; hands and sleeves still dark.
continuity_flag_definitions.REMI_BLOOD_3: After X11 (his mother wipes hairline, neck and hands) and R9b (hands scrubbed at the healer's bowl): hands clean, red from scrubbing; sleeves stained for the rest of the day.
continuity_flag_definitions.CHARCOAL_JAW_BLOOD: The scout's blood on Charcoal's lower jaw and throat from the bite until Remi washes it off in X15: wet at first, drying dark. Charcoal has no wound of his own.
continuity_flag_definitions.VILLAGER_INJURIES: Adult villager: split scalp (blood down one side of the face into the collar) and an open fracture of the RIGHT leg below the knee, from the second pass to the end; leg splinted with a banner pole in X27. He lives.
continuity_flag_definitions.NO_CHILD_IN_FRAME: Drink, smoke, drug or suggestive beat: no child (and not Abby or Remi) anywhere in frame (SERIES.md section 8).
continuity_flag_definitions.DEAD_ARE_ADULTS: Every dead body is an adult; partly covered or turned away, no faces, no lingering close-up.
continuity_flag_definitions.PENDING_WORDING: A line here keeps a scrapped dragon name until Daxtyn chooses new wording (DRAGONS.md): record it as written; plan a pickup for the alternative.

difficulty_tag_definitions.FACE_CLOSEUP: Human face in close-up: expression must read, and faces must stay consistent between shots.
difficulty_tag_definitions.LIPSYNC: On-camera speaking face: mouth shapes must match the recorded line.
difficulty_tag_definitions.WATER_IMPACT: Splash, spray and a churned trail on the sea surface.
difficulty_tag_definitions.DESTRUCTION: Breaking timber, tiles, turf, flying debris.
difficulty_tag_definitions.HEAD_IN_MOUTH: Charcoal holds Leaf's whole head in his jaws mid-flight without harm.
difficulty_tag_definitions.WING_SEPARATION: The scout's left wing tears loose (in silhouette, no gore).
difficulty_tag_definitions.FAST_PASS: A tiny object crossing frame at extreme speed (motion blur, wake).
difficulty_tag_definitions.HATCHLING_SOFTBODY: Wet, weak, soft-bodied newborn breaking out of a shell.
difficulty_tag_definitions.GOLD_MATERIAL: Believable gold scales that reflect but do not glow.
difficulty_tag_definitions.WHITE_SCALES: Reflective white scales that stay readable (not blown out, not glowing).
difficulty_tag_definitions.BLACK_HIDE: Black scales that must keep texture and highlights (not a flat silhouette).
difficulty_tag_definitions.HANDS_CONTACT: Hands touching or gripping objects or people.
difficulty_tag_definitions.MOUNTING_RIG: Characters climbing onto or off dragons via rigs or platforms.
difficulty_tag_definitions.BODY_MECHANICS: Believable human body weight and force.
difficulty_tag_definitions.CREATURE_CONTACT: Two creatures in physical contact (bite, struggle).
difficulty_tag_definitions.BLOOD: Blood on skin, scales, cloth, stone or water: wet and fresh, or drying.
difficulty_tag_definitions.GORE: Open wound, burn damage, exposed bone, torn wing root or membrane.
difficulty_tag_definitions.BODY_DEAD: Dead bodies, covered or partly seen.
difficulty_tag_definitions.PROP_DRINK_SMOKE: Cups, jugs, flasks, pipes and smoke handled on camera.
difficulty_tag_definitions.BIRDS: Flocks of seabirds lifting and wheeling.

shots.realism_strategy: Faces: the same approved build from scenes/lib/humans in every shot (never a regenerated face); 50-85 mm at eye level, three-quarter to the lens, focus on the near eye, shallow depth of field; key from the set's real sun or practical, soft bounce fill; living micro-motion (breath, blinks every 3-6 s, small eye saccades and head drift) so no frame freezes; cut when the performance ends.
